relationships.subject: Parvalbumin-positive sensory neurons
relationships.evidence_quote: Our findings demonstrate that PV+ neurons mediate tonic inhibition of nociceptive activity in peripheral sensory neurons within DRG.

relationships.subject: Parvalbumin-positive sensory neurons
relationships.evidence_quote: Parvalbumin-positive sensory neurons express the enzymes and transporters necessary to produce vesicular GABA that is known to be released from depolarized somata.

relationships.subject: Parvalbumin-positive sensory neurons
relationships.evidence_quote: Mice lacking sensory input from PV+ neurons showed augmented action potential firing of dorsal horn neurons to vibration, noxious mechanical, as well as noxious heat and cold stimuli.

relationships.subject: Bicuculline
relationships.evidence_quote: Intraplantar bicuculline significantly increased PGE2-driven spontaneous pain behaviour in littermate mice, but this effect is lost in the absence of PV neurons in DTA mice

key_findings: Ablating parvalbumin-positive proprioceptive sensory neurons enhances DRG nociceptor calcium responses, dorsal horn WDR firing and pain behaviour.
Bicuculline-enhanced PGE2 pain is lost without PV neurons, supporting a peripheral GABAergic gate within DRG.
